caption: The drawing depicts a single, rounded ceramic pot with a wide body and a narrow, slightly flared mouth. The upper half of the pot is glazed in green, with some uneven and patchy areas where the green is less intense, showing hints of the underlying surface or lighter colors. There are streaks of yellow glaze applied vertically, with the most prominent yellow section extending downward from the rim toward the midsection. The lower half of the pot transitions into a light brown or beige clay, with visible brushstrokes and some spots where the brown color appears faded or thin. A few irregular patches and streaks of pink and white are scattered across both the green and brown sections, suggesting worn areas or variations in the glazing. The pot sits on a plain, cream-colored background with no additional objects or decorative elements. The contour lines of the pot are clearly defined, and details, such as subtle shadows and highlights, suggest the three-dimensional form of the vessel.
title: Clay Flower Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
